title: GigaCascade: A Design-Only Comparative Test of Sauropod Gigantism

research_brief.question: Does a preregistered interaction model of feeding architecture, axial pneumaticity, growth/life-history proxies, and ecological opportunity predict repeated giant body-mass evolution in sauropodomorphs better than single-factor or additive alternatives?
research_brief.central_hypothesis: Constraint release is jointly explanatory and predictively useful only when the integrated model survives phylogenetic, temporal, and fossil uncertainty.
research_brief.scientific_object: taxon-time sauropodomorph lineages and matched dinosaur herbivore controls

analysis.primary: phylogenetically structured Bayesian path comparison with posterior propagation of mass, trait, date, and tree uncertainty
